syllabus_topics: Description of the movement of a system in Space and Time: Conservation laws and Space-Time Symmetries. Conservation of Energy (Mechanics), Linear Momentum, and Angular Momentum. Kinetic energy and potential energy.
Systems of particles. Isolated systems. Internal Forces and External Forces: Center of Mass. Work and Moment of a force. Conservative and dissipative systems.
Movement of the rigid body: Moment of Inertia.
Stability of Systems: Oscillations. Simple harmonic and damped oscillations.
Vibrations and general characteristics of Waves.
Thermodynamic system: Work and heat. Heat capacity, specific heat and latent heat. The states of matter. Phase transitions. Temperature. The ideal gas.
assessment_rules: For normal examination period, the final grade is calculated based on continuous assessment (MAP), 1st exam, and laboratory work. A minimum grade of 9.5 out of 20 is required for approval. The average of MAP + 1st Exam must be at least 8.0, and the laboratory grade must be at least 8.0. For the resit period, the 2nd exam accounts for 70% and laboratory work for 30%, with a minimum of 8.0 required in the 2nd Exam and a minimum final grade of 9.5 for approval. Students attending 'Estudo Acompanhado' may receive up to 2 bonus points on the theoretical part (MAP + Exam average), with a total theoretical grade cap of 16.0.
